verses.1: Beloved ones, do not believe everything that people say. Instead, test whether those claims come from God. Many false prophets have been sent into the world.
verses.2: In this, you will see the spirit of God. All spirits that Jesus Christ acknowledged as being from God when He was born in human form are indeed from God.
verses.3: And every spirit that does not confess Jesus as the Son of God is not worthy of being called a true spirit. This is what the anti-christ means; you heard that he will come, and now he already exists in this world.
verses.4: You are from God, children. You were born to Him, and you know that the one within you is greater than the one in this world.
verses.5: They come from the world itself. That’s why they speak from within the world, and the world listens to them.
verses.6: We are born from God. Those who know God listen to us; those who do not belong to God do not listen to us. Through this, we become aware of the spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
verses.7: Beloved ones, let us love one another, because love comes from God. And everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.
verses.8: He who does not love does not know the God; for love is indeed a characteristic of God.
verses.9: In this, the love of God towards us was revealed: that He sent His Son, the Son of God, into the world so that we might live through Him.
verses.10: In this lies love. It’s not that we have loved God, but rather that He loves us and sent His Son to save us from our sins.
verses.11: Beloved ones, if indeed God has loved us in this way, then it is our duty to love each other as well.
verses.12: No one ever enters the temple of God. If we love each other, then God remains among us, and His love is also fulfilled in us.
verses.13: In this, we see that he is also with us, and he himself is among us. He has given us his spirit.
verses.14: And we also testify that the Father has sent His Son as a savior of the world.
verses.15: Whoever admits that Jesus is the Son of God, then God remains in Him, and He also remains in God.
verses.16: And we have also recognized and believed in the love that God has for us. God’s love is indeed great; those who remain in this love will also remain in God, and God will remain in them.
verses.17: In this, love for us is fulfilled, so that we may have peace in the day of judgment. For just as he is, so also are we in this world.
verses.18: Fear is not present in true love. It is the ultimate love that eliminates fear. Fear brings destruction, while those who are afraid are not truly fulfilled in their love.
verses.19: We love Him, because He first loved us.
verses.20: If someone says that he loves the god, but hates his brother, then he is a liar. For those who do not love their brother, they certainly cannot love the god as well.
verses.21: And this is the command we receive from him: that he who loves the Lord should also love his brother.
